  "conj[oin]. Returns a new collection with the xs
  'added'. (conj nil item) returns (item).
  (conj coll) returns coll. (conj) returns [].

      (-conj coll x)

    (if xs
      (recur (conj coll x) (first xs) (next xs))
      (conj coll x)))))
